<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="ko_bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0a1014"/>
      <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#060a0d"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#03060a"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <radialGradient id="ko_vig" cx="0.5" cy="0.48" r="0.72">
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <linearGradient id="ko_sweep" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#7fe9d8" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#7fe9d8" stop-opacity="0.16"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7fe9d8" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Broadcast static. Animated seed makes it crawl the way a dead carrier does. -->
    <filter id="ko_static" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%">
      <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.85" numOctaves="3" seed="7" result="n">
        <animate attributeName="seed" values="7;33;12;51;7" dur="0.45s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </feTurbulence>
      <feColorMatrix in="n" type="saturate" values="0"/>
      <feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.5" intercept="-0.16"/></feComponentTransfer>
    </filter>

    <!-- The bloom on the ident, so it reads as phosphor rather than print. -->
    <filter id="ko_glow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3.2" result="b"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>

    <pattern id="ko_scan" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="4" height="2" fill="#000" opacity="0.34"/>
    </pattern>

    <clipPath id="ko_screen"><rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="360" rx="9"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <g clip-path="url(#ko_screen)">
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ko_bg)"/>

    <!-- Degraded colour bars: the old test card, most of its dyes gone. -->
    <g opacity="0.5">
      <rect x="0"   y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#6d7a7d"/>
      <rect x="80"  y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#9aa03f"/>
      <rect x="160" y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#3f8f95"/>
      <rect x="240" y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#3d7a45"/>
      <rect x="320" y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#8a4a78"/>
      <rect x="400" y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#96432f"/>
      <rect x="480" y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#2f3f86"/>
      <rect x="560" y="0" width="80" height="112" fill="#14181c"/>
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="112" fill="#000" opacity="0.42"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Alignment target, drifting a hair off centre because nothing here is maintained. -->
    <g transform="translate(320 178)" opacity="0.34" stroke="#7fe9d8" fill="none">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
                        values="320 178; 321.5 177; 319 179; 320 178" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>
      <circle r="96" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle r="64" stroke-width="0.7" opacity="0.6"/>
      <circle r="32" stroke-width="0.7" opacity="0.4"/>
      <path d="M-118 0H118M0-118V118" stroke-width="0.7" opacity="0.55"/>
      <path d="M-96 -68h24M-96 -60h24M-96 -52h24" stroke-width="1.4" opacity="0.5"/>
      <path d="M72 -68h24M72 -60h24M72 -52h24" stroke-width="1.4" opacity="0.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Station ident -->
    <g text-anchor="middle" filter="url(#ko_glow)">
      <text x="320" y="152" fill="#dff8f2" font-size="58" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="12">KSAB-7</text>
      <text x="320" y="174" fill="#7fe9d8" font-size="10.5" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="7.5" opacity="0.85">COLDWATER BASIN · PUBLIC MAST 04</text>
    </g>

    <!-- The message -->
    <g text-anchor="middle">
      <rect x="122" y="196" width="396" height="30" fill="#7a1c1c" opacity="0.34"/>
      <rect x="122" y="196" width="396" height="30" fill="none" stroke="#d24a3a" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.75"/>
      <text x="320" y="216" fill="#ffb9a8" font-size="15.5" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="5.6">TRANSMISSION SUSPENDED</text>

      <text x="320" y="248" fill="#9fb4b8" font-size="11" letter-spacing="0.6">The mast is up. The deck is cold. Nobody is upstairs.</text>
      <text x="320" y="266" fill="#7f9498" font-size="10" letter-spacing="0.4" opacity="0.9">Programming resumes when somebody walks back into the building.</text>
      <text x="320" y="284" fill="#5f7478" font-size="9" letter-spacing="0.4" opacity="0.85">Don't adjust your set. Adjusting your set has never once helped anybody.</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Carrier telemetry: the one thing still running, because it always is. -->
    <g font-size="8" letter-spacing="1.6" fill="#4d6266">
      <text x="22" y="330">CARRIER PRESENT</text>
      <text x="22" y="343" opacity="0.72">MOD 0.00 · SUBCARRIER LOCKED · NO SOURCE</text>
      <text x="618" y="330" text-anchor="end">LICENCE PENDING · RECLAMATION AUTHORITY</text>
      <text x="618" y="343" text-anchor="end" opacity="0.72">FILE 7-KSAB · STATUS: UNDER REVIEW SINCE 2082</text>
    </g>
    <circle cx="13" cy="327" r="3" fill="#d24a3a">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.06;1" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>

    <!-- Rolling frame-sync bar -->
    <rect x="0" width="640" height="46" fill="url(#ko_sweep)">
      <animate attributeName="y" values="-46;360" dur="7.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>

    <!-- Grain, scanlines, vignette, and a slow overall flicker -->
    <rect width="640" height="360" filter="url(#ko_static)" opacity="0.2"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ko_scan)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ko_vig)"/>
    <rect width="640" height="360" fill="#000" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.1;0;0.05;0" dur="5.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="639" height="359" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="#1d2a2e" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
description: KSAB-7 off-air card: carrier-present test pattern (SVG). Doesn't replace ksab7offline.
name: ksab7offline_carrier
